subject.title: feat(cli): add `agents` and `<agent> models` runtime discovery commands

question: Should `acpx` reserve `agents` and `models` as permanent top-level verbs, or provide runtime discovery without changing existing positional raw-adapter resolution?
rationale: The choice establishes long-lived CLI keywords and an upgrade behavior for existing raw-adapter scripts; it cannot be resolved safely by tests alone.

options.title: Adopt compatibility-first discovery
options.body: Keep positional raw-adapter resolution intact and expose discovery through a non-conflicting namespace or explicit opt-in syntax.

options.title: Reserve the names deliberately
options.body: Accept the positional compatibility break, document the `--agent` migration path, and add upgrade coverage for the affected scripts.

options.title: Defer the core surface
options.body: Leave runtime discovery to downstream tooling until a stable ACP-client contract is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Adopt compatibility-first discovery
recommendation.body: Keep positional raw-adapter resolution intact and expose discovery through a non-conflicting namespace or explicit opt-in syntax.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the proposed command surface and are the best evidenced routing contact for clarifying the intended contract, while final acceptance remains a core maintainer decision.
